stages.name: spec_check
stages.description: Checks whether spec.md and constitution.md exist, are internally consistent, and are sufficiently complete to judge correctness.

stages.name: clarification
stages.description: Requests clarification when the specification is missing, ambiguous, or internally inconsistent. No assumptions are allowed.

stages.name: judgment
stages.description: Judges whether the proposed artifact or plan is aligned with the intent and scope of the specification.

stages.name: validation
stages.description: Validates the artifact against spec.md and constitution.md, identifying concrete violations or confirming compliance.

stages.name: spec_revision
stages.description: Handles proposed spec changes with HITL review.

stages.name: block
stages.description: Blocks progress due to specification violations or constitutional breaches. Provides reasons and required corrective actions.

stages.name: approval
stages.description: Confirms that the artifact complies with the specification and constitution. Allows downstream stages or delivery.
